source: ServiceTitan Security RTI export (job type 2054262), reconstructed from get_dispatch_board, search_payments, search_open_invoices and get_job_history; snapshot cutoffs America/Los_Angeles
notes: SCOPE: ServiceTitan job type 'Returning to Install Security Products' (2054262) only; one row per job ID. Business units follow the Security data contract: the BU name contains 'Security', or it is one of the SoCal/Arizona/Austin/Las Vegas/Dallas 'Service Call' BUs. Chimney, Gas & Pellet, Masonry and Screens are excluded. Job 141966090 (NorCal - Screens Install; a $200 counter sale of mesh, picked up 2025-04-24) is excluded with its sale and cash. Excluded-RMA: job text says RMA, remake, re-make or remesh (prefix match, so 'remeshed' counts), plus 188624146 as classified in the saved verified workbook. Excluded-not a sale: 189363597 and 189367308, ViewGuard reinstall/removal visits with no estimate or project, as classified in the saved workbook. Jobs with a $0 invoice stay in the headline count at $0, matching the saved workbook (e.g. 187427980, which has no invoice items, and 189602094, a $0 trade for sign services). Canceled jobs are excluded unless canceled after a cutoff (see CANCELED). Job universe = every RTI job with an appointment on get_dispatch_board 2024-01-01..2027-04-03 (4,320 jobs). Open RTI jobs with no appointment at all cannot be seen, so unscheduledRevenue is null except on the verified 2026-09-28 point.

SOURCE WINDOWS: get_dispatch_board monthly pulls 2024-01..2027-04-03 (none truncated); search_payments monthly 2023-10-01..2026-09-30 (14,912 payments, none truncated); search_open_invoices (462 open invoices, not truncated); get_job_history for the 29 jobs currently on Hold. All pulled 2026-09-28 ~15:55-16:15 PT.

VALUES: job value = current invoice value = applied payments + current open-invoice balance. Spot-checked against get_job_invoices combinedInvoiceTotal on jobs 187758860 ($68,490.20) and 189733004 ($5,200.00): exact match. Cashflow pipeline = invoice value minus applied credits (cash, refunds, write-offs) with payment date before the cutoff, floored at 0. Payment dates are ServiceTitan paymentDate business dates.

QUALITY OF THE 2026-09-28 POINT: the weekly 2026-09-28 row and the daily 2026-09-27 row (the same Monday 12:00 AM PT snapshot) are marked 'verified'. Their job lists, values and Hold lists reproduce the saved verified workbook, which was built from Job Booked/Completed/Canceled/Hold history. Caveat: the rolling 3-month split uses appointment dates read on 2026-09-28 afternoon, not at midnight. All earlier rows stay 'reconstructed'. They use today's appointment dates and invoice values, and hold, reopen and cancel history was only pulled for 223 jobs, so a job with an unlogged hold release or reopen before mid-2026 could be misclassified in an older row.

SAVED-CLASSIFICATION CAVEAT: 188624146 is excluded as remake at 9/14 and 9/21 too, following the saved workbook. But the evidence is a technician note dated 2026-09-23 (door built to the wrong width; return 10/17), and the job summary has no RMA/remake text. At the 9/14 and 9/21 cutoffs this job looked like a normal $4,689.96 sale. If you'd rather count it as Active until 9/23, those two Mondays rise by $4,689.96 and 1 job. 188719647 ($4,724.06) is excluded because its summary says the 10/1 visit refits a 'remeshed' slider; it may still carry the original sale value.

QUALITY: every historical row is 'reconstructed', not 'verified'. No true point-in-time snapshots exist for this rolling measure; pipelines are rebuilt from today's job statuses, today's appointment dates and today's invoice values. Appointment reschedules, invoice edits, hold releases and job reopenings before each cutoff cannot be verified. Cash fields (sales excepted) are built from individual payment records, but the rows are still marked reconstructed because their pipeline fields are.

WEEKLY: cutoff = Monday 12:00 AM America/Los_Angeles. Scheduled window = [cutoff, same calendar day three months later at 12:00 AM), END EXCLUSIVE (e.g. 2026-09-28 -> 2026-12-28 exclusive). A job counts if it was booked before the cutoff, was not completed before the cutoff (completion = end of its last active appointment's Pacific day; ServiceTitan completion lag measured at <=1 day), is not on Hold at the cutoff, and has an active (non-canceled) appointment starting inside the window. beyondWindowRevenue = open, non-Hold jobs whose next active appointment is on/after the window end. sales/deposits/installPayments/refunds/netCash = the preceding Monday-Sunday Pacific week and equal the sum of the matching daily rows.

DAILY: end-of-day Pacific snapshot. Window = next midnight through December 31 of the row's calendar year, inclusive, so Dec 31 rows have an empty window and show 0 by definition. Actual daily rows run 2024-01-01..2026-09-27. 2026-09-28 (today, still in progress at export time) onward is forecast.

BOOKING/SALES DATE: the 'Job Booked' timestamp from get_job_history is used for 223 jobs (Hold jobs, jobs near the 9/14, 9/21 and 9/28 cutoffs, jobs not in Scheduled status, recently canceled jobs, and 171968933). Other jobs are dated from the job ID's position in ServiceTitan's global ID sequence, calibrated on 14,912 payment createdOn times plus the known booking times. Older daily 'sales' values can land a day early or late.

CASH: payments are matched to eligible Security RTI jobs by invoice number (= job number) on each appliedTo row; refunds with no applied invoice go through refundedPaymentId to the original payment's job; other unapplied amounts go to the customer's only live RTI job. deposit = cash dated before the job's first active install appointment date (Pacific), or any cash on a job with no active appointment. installPayments = cash dated on or after the first install appointment. refunds = positive dollars. 'Write Off / Bad Debt' entries are not cash; they reduce the balance only. Payment IDs are deduped. Chimney/fireplace/gas cash and cash on non-RTI jobs are excluded; see the audit workbook's 'Excluded payments' sheet.

AMBIGUOUS CASH: 5 unapplied payments match more than one live RTI job for the same customer, so their deposit/balance role can't be decided. The affected field is null on those days: 2024-07-30, 2025-01-24, 2025-10-28, 2026-06-15, 2026-08-26. The containing weeks are null for the same fields, as is netCash.

CANCELED: ServiceTitan zeroes the invoice when a job is canceled. 19 RTI jobs with 2026 activity that were later canceled were checked with get_job_history (cancel time) and get_job_estimates (the project's sold estimates). A job booked before a cutoff and canceled after it counts at that cutoff, valued at its ORIGINAL (earliest-sold) estimate, the rule the saved workbook uses. Its recorded, now-canceled appointment date is used as the install date. Counted: 189373068 at $4,781.41, 189316111 at $8,273.29 and 189794473 at $4,000.00 at 9/14; 190180377 at $5,622.72 at 9/21. Jobs whose earliest sold estimates tie, or that have no estimate, are Unverifiable-value and kept out. Jobs canceled before June 2026 (81) were not checked, so rows before mid-2026 may miss a job canceled after that cutoff (understatement).

HOLD / UNVERIFIABLE: a current Hold job counts as Hold from its latest 'Job Hold' event; ServiceTitan logs no hold-release or reopen events. Unverifiable-hold jobs are left out of the headline and the Hold totals: jobs on Hold now with no Hold event (123846326, 142195009, 141583280), and jobs held in the past whose release isn't logged (64632267, held 2024-01-10 'customer refused to pay'; 171968933, held 2026-08-20). Unverifiable-reopen jobs are also left out: jobs completed or canceled before a cutoff and open again later (178458387, 142195009, 186478483, 188955788, 189565840, 188689038, and 144795408, canceled 2025-10-20). holdRevenue/holdCashflow are filled only for 2026-09-14, 09-21 and 09-28 and the matching daily closes. At those cutoffs the Hold job list reproduces the saved verified workbook exactly ($220,696.30 / $225,311.47 / $225,311.47). Earlier Hold totals are null because released holds cannot be dated.

RECONCILIATION TO THE SAVED VERIFIED WORKBOOK (Den_Defenders_Weekly_Installation_Pipeline_VERIFIED_1.xlsx, Snapshot detail): after applying its classifications, the rebuilt all-open headline and Hold lists match job-for-job and dollar-for-dollar on all three Mondays. Headline: 9/14 $959,463.07 (154 jobs), 9/21 $990,282.65 (157), 9/28 $1,024,752.01 (154). Hold: 23 / 24 / 24 jobs. No job-ID or bucket differences remain. The dashboard headline (revenuePipeline) is the rolling 3-month part of that list. At 9/28 it is $1,015,541.93 across 152 jobs; the other $9,210.08 across 2 jobs has no future appointment (unscheduledRevenue: 172589606 at $9,210.08, and a $0 job).

EARLY-DEPOSIT GAP (2024): payments before 2023-10-01 were not pulled, and jobs booked before 2023-10-01 cannot be dated from the ID sequence (they are marked 'booked before 2023-10-01'). 28 eligible jobs of that kind had no open balance, so their value could not be rebuilt from payments. For those 28, the invoice total was pulled directly with get_job_invoices ($170,412.04 total; all fully paid). The pre-Oct-2023 portion of their payments (totalPaid minus payments captured in the pull) is treated as a credit dated before every 2024 cutoff, so it reduces cashflowPipeline but is never counted as cash in any row. Cash received before 2024-01-01 (including Oct-Dec 2023 deposits) is not in any daily row. Deposits collected before October 2023 on other jobs are covered by their open-invoice balances. No row was nulled for this gap.

SOLD ESTIMATES CROSS-CHECK (Sold Estimates PDF, 27 entries, $262,123.65, BU All, 8/13/2024..10/12/2026): addresses were matched on street number + first street word (skipping N/S/E/W) against RTI job locations, then every customer's jobs were confirmed with get_customer_jobs. 5 entries match a real RTI job and are retained. #3 -> 187314984 (on Hold, in the Hold subtotal). #9 -> 186098224 (installed 2026-06). #11 -> 190553137 (booked 2026-09-28 1:51 PM PT, after the 9/28 cutoff, so its first Monday is 10/5; invoice = PDF $4,776.59). #12 -> 183191732 (installed). #18 -> 185169179 (installed). 2 entries (#4, #13) match only an older, unrelated RTI job; they are ambiguous and not linked. 20 entries ($143,946.56) have no RTI job at all. They are sold estimates with no install job created, so they are NOT in any pipeline figure. No estimate was turned into a job. Three PDF totals differ from ServiceTitan: #3 $72,295.14 vs sold estimate $69,149.67 vs invoice $73,538.84; #9 $18,300.32 vs $18,018.01; #12 $13,689.49 is an add-on estimate on the RTI job. Entry numbers and addresses are in the audit sheet 'Estimate cross-check'.

FORECAST (2026-09-28 .. 2027-03-31, quality 'forecast', NOT received cash): cash fields = the same weekday 364 days earlier x the trailing-13-week year-over-year growth factor for that field (13 weeks ending 2026-09-27 vs the same 2025 weeks: sales 1.404, deposits 1.141, installPayments 1.416, refunds scaled with deposits+installPayments 1.308). Pipeline fields and jobCount = the value 364 days earlier x (current value / value 364 days before the anchor); anchors are the 2026-09-27 daily row and the 2026-09-28 weekly row. Hold/unscheduled/beyond-window are not forecast (null). Backtest of the same method from a 2025-09-29 origin over 26 weeks: weekly revenue-pipeline MAPE 14% (median 13%); weekly deposits+install cash MAPE 27% (median 24%). Treat any single forecast week as roughly +/-27%, and single forecast days as much noisier.
PRIVACY: no customer names or addresses appear in this file. Job-, invoice- and payment-level evidence is in the separate audit workbook, which references customers by ServiceTitan customer ID only.
